Thanks, Tim. I've passed your number on with a note that the call is about replacing the KBOX. Someone will pick up your ticket and call you.

You're right about the KBOX. GekkoScience has no units left, so we need to find you a replacement. Whoever calls will go through the options with you. If you'd like to see what's in stock before then, tell me and I'll pull the current options and what each would cost on your order.
Sure. I would like to know what you have in stock that is comparable to the k-box roughly around the same price 774.49 is what I paid.

Here's what's comparable, Tim. Your KBOX line cost $800, and I've priced each option against that.

**Two Hammer Thor P2s** ($698, 20 TH/s together). These are in stock and ship within 2 business days. You'd get $102 back as store credit.

**Harlo B30** ($899, about 30 TH/s). This is a pre-order that ships by Nov 30, 2026. It would be $99 more.

**Harlo H15 Dual** ($799, mines Bitcoin and Dogecoin). This is also a pre-order that ships by Nov 30, 2026. You'd get $1 back to your card.

Tell me which one you want and I'll change the order right now. Or you can talk it through on the call first.

You're welcome, Tim. Someone will call you on (phone hidden) about the KBOX. Whenever you decide which option you want, just reply here and I'll change the order straight away. Your Magic M. 40T ships November 30, and the tracking will come to this email.
Glad I could help, Tim. Have a good rest of your day.
